t1369.bio: Ibn Ḥajar describes Ḥuṣayn ibn ʿAbd al-Raḥmān al-Sulamī, Abū al-Hudhayl al-Kūfī, as trustworthy though his memory changed late in life; he died in 36 AH at age 93, of the fifth generation.
as: He is trustworthy, but his memory changed in his later years.
Aḥmad ibn Ḥanbal, quoted by al-Mizzī
حصين بن عبد الرحمن الثقة المأمون من كبار أصحاب الحديث
Ḥuṣayn ibn ʿAbd al-Raḥmān was reliable, trustworthy, and among the senior specialists in hadith.
Yaḥyā ibn Maʿīn, quoted by al-Mizzī
كوفي ثقة ثبت في الحديث سكن المبارك بأخرة، والواسطيون أروى الناس عنه
A Kufan, reliable and precise in hadith. He settled in al-Mubārak late in life. The people of Wāsiṭ transmitted the most from him.
Abū Zurʿah al-Rāzī, quoted by al-Mizzī
ثقة. قلت: يحتج بحديثه؟ قال: إي والله
Reliable. Asked whether his hadith could be used as proof, he answered, ‘Yes, by God.’
Abū Ḥātim al-Rāzī, quoted by al-Mizzī
صدوق ثقة في الحديث وفي آخر عمره ساء حفظه
Truthful and reliable in hadith. His memory deteriorated at the end of his life.
للقاسم بن الوليد, quoted by al-Mizzī
هل رأيت بعينيك مثل طلحة بن مصرف؟ قال: نعم، حصين بن عبد الرحمن
Asked if he had seen anyone like Ṭalḥah ibn Muṣarrif, al-Qāsim named Ḥuṣayn ibn ʿAbd al-Raḥmān.
